title: A83 Lyric-OS
description: Chrome extension that turns any webpage into full song lyrics with AI. Pick a genre, generate structured lyrics, and send them to Suno or Udio.
longDescription: Extract the real content from any article or page, transform it into structured lyrics, and move from text to song in under a minute.
heroTag: // TURN ANY WEBSITE INTO A SONG
heroTagline:
Extract any webpage.
Turn signal into lyrics.
Export to Suno or Udio in seconds.
mockupSubtitle: Lyric-OS extracts the real page content, applies a genre persona, and returns structured lyrics ready for music generation.
featuresSubtitle: Everything the draft promised, mapped into the same extension page system as PromptVault.

features.title: SMART EXTRACTION
features.desc: Strips navigation, ads, sidebars, and footer noise to focus on the actual content of the page.

features.title: 5 GENRES
features.desc: Generate lyrics in Synth-Wave, Industrial, Punk-Rock, Dark Pop, or Trap with dedicated prompt logic.

features.title: EN / DE
features.desc: Switch between English and German output with one click and keep your preferred language between sessions.

features.title: FLEXIBLE AI SOURCES
features.desc: Use your Anthropic API key directly or route prompts through Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini in the browser.

features.title: SUNO & UDIO READY
features.desc: Formats the result for music generators and gets you from webpage to produced track with minimal friction.

features.title: PRIVACY FIRST
features.desc: API credentials stay in local browser storage and content only leaves the browser for the generation step you trigger.

themesSubtitle: Use direct API generation for speed or browser-based AI and music tools when you want a no-setup workflow.

steps.title: OPEN ANY PAGE
steps.desc: Load any article, blog post, product page, or news page and let the extension isolate the meaningful content.

steps.title: CHOOSE YOUR STYLE
steps.desc: Pick a genre, language, and AI route, then shape the source material into a songwriting prompt.

steps.title: GENERATE & EXPORT
steps.desc: Get Verse, Chorus, Bridge, and more in the extension, then copy or send the result to Suno or Udio.

pricingSubtitle: The extension itself is free. Support the project if you want faster iteration, then choose the workflow that fits your setup.

features.text: Works with your own API key

ctaTitle: READY TO TURN CONTENT INTO TRACKS?
ctaSubtitle: Install the extension, pick a genre, and convert any page into structured lyrics in under a minute.
